title: Consent to service of process.
bodyText: An applicant for registration under this chapter that is not domiciled in the State shall complete an irrevocable consent to service of process, in a form approved by the attorney general.
bodyHtml: [§466M-12]  Consent to service of process.  An applicant for registration under this chapter that is not domiciled in the State shall complete an irrevocable consent to service of process, in a form approved by the attorney general. [L 2024, c 80, pt of §2]
